goal: window title, current document and unsaved marker
positive_oracle: Switch active document changes title and unsaved indicator without stale UI refs
negative_oracle: Close document with unsaved changes requires explicit decision
checkout_note: As recorded for OM9-L3-01-01-004: the pinned revision is verified in vendor-research/QymCAD; QymCAD/ is not a git checkout here.
method: git rev-parse HEAD + git status in the pinned checkout, then bounded file reads with line numbers. Decisions are OM9-owned; no upstream code is copied.

observed_symbols: gui.rs:22 comment: the title starts as the program's name, not empty — an empty title bar at launch reads as a window without a program
gui.rs:1588 fn keep_the_title_current — the title follows the document: which file is open, and whether it holds unsaved work
gui.rs:1598-1601 the viewport title is sent only when it changed, because a command every frame makes some window managers flicker
planned_anchors.what_is_missing: The title rule and the send-only-on-change rule are the same in OM9. QymCAD's dirty flag is a REBUILD flag (gui.rs:118, 816, 1001) — 'the geometry needs work', not 'the document differs from the file'. OM9 keeps the two apart.

QymCAD's exit path uses an allow_close flag: unsaved work is not put to the user as a decision. OM9 requires an explicit Save/Discard/Cancel answer before a close with unsaved changes (the negative oracle of this item).

observed_symbols: qymcad-shell/src/lib.rs:113 pub fn put(&mut self, p: Place)
planned_anchors.what_is_missing: The shell has no notion of an active document: no title, no file identity, no unsaved marker.
Tool and geometry state only; nothing about the active document or the window title.
